title_en: Enforcement Regulation of the National Pension Act (Update Listing)
summary_en: This item is an entry from the e-Gov Law Search law-update listing concerning the Enforcement Regulation of the National Pension Act (Ministry of Health and Welfare Ordinance No. 12 of 1960). According to the metadata, it reflects an amending ordinance (Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare Ordinance No. 132 of 2011), with a stated promulgation date of 2011-10-21 and a stated enforcement date of 2017-04-01. The listing appears in an update index dated 2026-09-17.
business_impact_en: Organizations involved in national pension administration or related labor and social-insurance obligations may need to consider how this enforcement regulation and its amendment affect their procedures.
recommended_action_en: Review the official Japanese text on e-Gov Law Search to confirm the current status, dates, and specific provisions before drawing any conclusions.
